scope: Finite CF32 input streamed through a causal compiler during RF. Input I/Q is prepared before the test; only first two command buffers are precompiled. No payload averaging or across-frame RX fitting. Stream timing/order are used only for scoring; indefinite upstream I/O and emission masks remain unqualified.
